facts.fact: The Ministry of Education KEMIS Secretariat circular says KEMIS holds learner records marked Valid or Invalid by an operational Learner Validation Engine and generates a Unique Learner Identifier (ULI) for learners in schools.

The circular says KEMIS compares learner records against KNEC examination and assessment databases and that parent or guardian identity details are needed for ULI creation and integration with national identity and civil registration records.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education, State Department for Basic Education
